serviceDescription: Lazarus Alliance is a veteran-owned small business (VOSB) and A2LA-accredited Independent Assessment Service (ISO/IEC 17020 #3822.01). We provide independent FedRAMP 3PAO assessments (including native 20x Class A, B, and C, Moderate, High, and equivalency pathways), CMMC C3PAO assessments, and related cybersecurity compliance services. Our AI-Enhanced Cybervisor™ teams and automation platform support efficient, evidence-driven assessments for cloud service providers seeking certification.

servicesOffered.serviceDescription: Independent 3PAO assessments for FedRAMP, including native 20x Class A, B, and C, Rev5 readiness and assessments, Moderate/High baselines, significant change requests, continuous monitoring validation, and equivalency pathways. A2LA-accredited under ISO/IEC 17020 #3822.01.
Authorized CMMC Third-Party Assessment Organization (C3PAO, CPN 10251) assessments for CMMC Level 2, including readiness, gap analysis, formal assessments, and continuous monitoring support.
Accelerated equivalency programs and cross-framework assessments leveraging existing Moderate authorizations for additional agency ATOs, DoD IL4/IL5, GovRAMP/StateRAMP, and related pathways.
Independent third-party assessment services for GovRAMP and StateRAMP, including readiness, full assessments, and continuous monitoring for state and local government cloud offerings.
Independent SOC 1, SOC 2, and SOC 3 examinations and readiness assessments for service organizations, including Type 1 and Type 2 reports.
Qualified Security Assessor (QSA) services for PCI DSS, including Reports on Compliance (RoC), SAQs, gap analysis, and remediation support.

servicesOffered.serviceName: ISO/IEC 27001 and Related Management System Audits
servicesOffered.serviceDescription: Independent audits and certification support for ISO/IEC 27001, 27701, 27017, 27018, 27002, 27005, 42001, 9001, and related standards.
Security control assessments, gap analyses, and readiness support against NIST SP 800-53, NIST SP 800-171, NIST CSF 2.0, and related federal and defense baselines.
HIPAA Security Rule assessments, HITECH-related reviews, and supporting readiness and gap analysis services (including NIST 800-66 alignment).
Independent assessments and gap analyses for the Criminal Justice Information Services (CJIS) Security Policy.
Independent assessments and gap analyses for International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) compliance requirements.
Assessments and readiness support for DFARS NIST SP 800-171 and related controlled unclassified information (CUI) requirements.
Independent assessments and readiness support for IRS Publication 1075 and 4812 safeguarding requirements.
Independent audit, assessment, and readiness services for the CMS ARC-AMPE (Acceptable Risk Controls for ACA, Medicaid, and Partner Entities) framework.
Assessments and readiness support for the German C5 (Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue) framework.
NERC CIP and related 693-based audit assessments and readiness support for bulk electric system entities.
ACAB DMF (Data Management Framework) audit and certification assessments.
Privacy impact assessments and related privacy compliance reviews, including support for GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, and other privacy frameworks.
Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) 302 and 404 assessment and related internal control support.
Independent vulnerability assessments, penetration testing, red team exercises, static and dynamic code analysis, wireless security testing, social engineering, and phishing testing.
FISMA-aligned security control assessments and Security Control Assessment & Validation (SCA-V) services.

servicesOffered.serviceName: Readiness, Gap Analysis, and Continuous Monitoring
servicesOffered.serviceDescription: Pre-assessment readiness reviews, gap analyses, SPRS support, continuous monitoring validation, policy and governance development, and Cybervisor™ advisory services across multiple frameworks.
